summary: Hua Takhe is a lived-in, century-old timber market community beside Khlong Prawet Burirom in Lat Krabang. Come for the narrow canal-side walkways, old shopfronts, local cafes and an unhurried look at Bangkok's eastern edge; it is a neighbourhood visit rather than a large, continuously busy attraction.
whyGo: See a distinctive canal junction and surviving wooden shophouse community on Bangkok's eastern fringe.
Browse small cafes, food shops and community craft or art spaces, with a slower pace than central Bangkok.
Walk the old market lanes and watch ordinary canal-side neighbourhood life respectfully.
bestFor: Travellers interested in local neighbourhoods, architecture and low-key photography.
A half-day outing paired with Lat Krabang or the airport area.
skipIf: You expect a large market with every stall operating daily; weekend daytime is the safer bet for open shops.
You need step-free, smooth paths throughout or want a tightly scheduled attraction with guaranteed activities.
duration: Allow 2–3 hours for the market lanes, a meal or cafe stop and a relaxed canal-side visit; treat this as a planning estimate.
cost: No general market admission is listed. Budget separately for food, drinks and shopping; prices vary by vendor. A current fare for local songthaew/train connections and any boat or kayak outing was not reliably verified, so confirm locally and carry small cash.
hours: Thailand's Department of Tourism directory lists the market's visitor hours as Saturday–Sunday, 10:00–18:00. The community cafe page lists Si Yaek Huatakhe Cafe & Guesthouse as open 10:00–19:00 weekdays and 09:00–19:00 weekends. Individual businesses vary; check their current page before travelling.
bestTime: Choose a Saturday or Sunday, arriving around 10:00–11:00 for the best chance of finding food and small businesses open. December is generally more comfortable for walking than Bangkok's hotter season, but expect sun and humidity; bring water. Weekdays are quieter and some vendors may be closed.
gettingThere: The closest rail stop is Hua Takhe on SRT's Eastern Line; check the live SRT timetable for a suitable train and return before setting out. Another route is Airport Rail Link to Lat Krabang, then a local songthaew or taxi to Soi Lat Krabang 17/Udomphon Market and walk into the old market. The community gives its address as Soi Lat Krabang 17, Lat Krabang, Bangkok 10520. A community longtail boat trip is mentioned in local travel coverage, but its operating days, price and boarding point are not confirmed; do not rely on it without checking with the operator.
booking: No admission or advance booking requirement is published for the market. Reserve or contact a specific cafe, workshop or boat provider directly if it is the reason for your visit; the community site lists Si Yaek Huatakhe Cafe & Guesthouse and the community contact details.
accessibility: Expect narrow lanes and timber walkways beside active homes and canals; surfaces and level changes may be uneven. Step-free access, accessible toilets and assistance for visitors with mobility needs are not documented in the sources reviewed. Contact the community or a venue in advance and avoid assuming all lanes are wheelchair accessible.
practicalTips: Use the SRT timetable for the exact travel date and allow time for a local connection from Lat Krabang ARL if using that route.
Take small cash and check individual food and cafe hours; market-wide hours do not guarantee every shop is open.
Walk carefully on the waterside paths, keep noise low around homes and ask before photographing residents.
Ask locally before arranging a boat ride or kayak: schedules, prices and availability are not confirmed centrally.
decemberNotes: For December 2026, weekend daytime is the best-supported window, with the Department of Tourism directory listing 10:00–18:00 on Saturdays and Sundays. These are current published hours, not a guarantee for a future date; confirm around the visit, especially during holiday periods. No dated December 2026 market event was found.
uncertainties: Market-wide hours, vendor participation and any holiday changes should be reconfirmed for the chosen December 2026 date.
Exact local train fares and times, songthaew fare/frequency, and boat or kayak availability and prices were not verified; check directly with SRT and local operators.
Accessibility details and public toilet provision are not established by the sources reviewed.
